description: What the agent decides and what reaches the game: decision cycles, decide backend x outcome (spanmetrics from agent.decide spans), remote-backend GenAI metrics, interventions from the agent and the coordinator side, measured effect, shadow games and agent process health. Agent and game metrics carry no job filter; only the process panels match the job, with or without the namespace prefix. Replaces Agent Operations — Fleet and Interventions (#1427).

panels.description: Games whose loop is running, by kind: primary = the real (menu) game, shadow = headless agent games. game_active is 1 while a game runs; each game has its own series (game_id).
panels.title: Running Games

panels.description: Agent decision cycles per minute by outcome (a rule fired and produced decisions, or nothing to do). Source: agent_evaluations_total{signal,outcome}.
panels.title: Evaluation Cycles / min (by outcome)

panels.description: agent.decide spans per minute by the backend that produced the answers (decide.backend: rules, jev, claude, openai; rules after a fallback). Derived in the OTel collector by the spanmetrics connector from the agent.decide spans (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, services/otel-collector/config.yaml): the agent has no counter for this. A decision.backend flag flip shows here within a minute.
panels.title: Decisions / min (by backend)

panels.description: Share of agent.decide spans by decide.outcome: act (routed to the permission chain), noop (the backend chose no action), held (a valid answer below the act confidence threshold), fallback (the requested backend could not decide; rules did), invalid (inconsistent answers) and discarded (the answer no longer fit the game when it landed). Each series is its share of all agent.decide spans over the last minute (computed in PromQL, so the stack sums to 100%). Source: traces_span_metrics_calls_total (spanmetrics connector).
panels.title: Decide Outcome Split

panels.description: p95 duration of the agent.decide span by backend: the backend call for a remote backend, the ranking time for rules. From the spanmetrics duration histogram (explicit buckets 5 ms to 32 s, services/otel-collector/config.yaml).
panels.title: Decide Latency p95 (by backend)

panels.description: agent.decide spans in the selected time range by backend and outcome (increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total).
panels.title: Backend x Outcome (time range)

panels.description: Share of agent.decide spans in the last 5 minutes whose requested backend could not decide, so rules did (decide.outcome=fallback): an unreachable or misconfigured remote backend. 0 while decision.backend=rules.
panels.title: Fallback Share (5m)

panels.description: Why a remote decision backend (decision.backend != rules) or a post-game retro was not called, by gate reason: llm_not_eligible (game kind not in llm.eligible_game_kinds, e.g. shadow games), decide_interval (decision.min_interval_ms cadence), llm_budget_exhausted (llm.max_requests_per_minute spent), no_interventions_allowed (interventions_allowed is none / noop only, or in an experiment game only levers of the flag under test, #1298, #2251), and the configuration fallbacks unknown_backend, backend_unavailable (no API key / model / base URL) and async_not_wired, counted every cycle. 0 (none) while nothing is gated. Source: agent_llm_gated_total.
panels.title: Remote Decide Gated / min (by reason)

panels.description: Agent decisions in the selected time range by game kind (primary = real games, shadow = shadow games), action, blocked and block reason (increase of agent_decisions_total). Replaces the Jaeger trace-search table that Grafana 13 cannot run against Jaeger 2.21+ (jaeger#7594); open a single trace from the Jaeger UI at /jaeger/.
panels.title: Agent decisions by game kind and action

panels.description: p95 of gen_ai.client.operation.duration (OTel GenAI semantic conventions; Prometheus name gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds) per requested model, recorded by the claude, openai and jev backends for every chat call, failed calls included. Buckets: the semconv advisory boundaries (10 ms to 82 s).
panels.title: Model Call Latency p95 (by model)

panels.description: Chat calls per minute per requested model and provider; error_type is set only on failed calls (timeout, HTTP status class, ...). Source: gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count.
panels.title: Model Calls / min (by model, error type)

panels.description: Input and output tokens per minute per requested model, from gen_ai.client.token.usage (Prometheus name gen_ai_client_token_usage, a histogram; the _sum is the token count).
panels.title: Tokens / min (by model, token type)

panels.description: Agent decisions per minute: applied (blocked=false, dispatched) and blocked before dispatch by reason (not_allowed, battery_threshold, rate_limit, ...). already_applied is not a refusal: the decided value was already in place, so nothing was written (UC-040 A35). Source: agent_decisions_total{blocked,block_reason}.
panels.title: Agent Decisions: Applied vs Blocked / min

panels.description: Interventions the agent wrote per minute, by action; a decision the interventions_enabled gate turned into a no-op is not counted. Source: agent_interventions_applied_total.
panels.title: Interventions Dispatched / min (by action)

panels.description: Interventions the game coordinator applied per minute, by type. Source: game_interventions_total{blocked="false"}.
panels.title: Coordinator Applied / min (by type)

panels.description: Applied interventions per minute by the objective they serve. Source: game_interventions_total{blocked="false"}.
panels.title: Coordinator Applied / min (by objective)

panels.description: Intervention attempts the coordinator refused, by block_reason. 0 (none) while nothing is blocked. Source: game_interventions_total{blocked="true"}.
panels.title: Coordinator Blocked / min (by reason)

panels.description: Blocked share of intervention attempts at the coordinator over the last 5 minutes (0 when there were none). Source: game_interventions_total.
panels.title: Coordinator Blocked Ratio (5m)

panels.description: Interventions whose handler raised (game_interventions_total{block_reason="handler_error"}) and side effects that did not complete on their game's loop (game_intervention_dispatch_failures_total{reason}: game_loop_unavailable, game_loop_timeout, game_loop_late). 0 (none) while healthy.
panels.title: Handler Errors and Dispatch Failures / min

panels.description: Intervention flag writes by the agent that failed in the last hour (agent_intervention_writes_total{result="error"}).
panels.title: Agent Write Errors (1h)

panels.description: Agent flag writes the flag service refused in the last hour (flagservice_writes_total{result="rejected"} on the interventions, rollout and game sets): out of bounds, game not live, read-only flag. Replaces the flag-file corruption panel (#1417).
panels.title: Rejected writes, agent flag sets (1h)

panels.description: Intervention flag writes by the agent per minute, by result. Source: agent_intervention_writes_total.
panels.title: Agent Flag Writes / min (by result)

panels.description: Median change in a fitness signal a follow-up window (20 s) after an applied intervention, per signal (endurance / accelerate session_progress, balanced skill_gap, skill_gap_progress, spike_survival_*). Positive progress = the game moved toward the objective (for skill_gap, negative is better). Only the 0..1 progress-type signals reach the metric (#1444), so the buckets (-1 to 1) fit every series. Source: agent_intervention_effect_delta.
panels.title: Effect Delta p50 (by signal)

panels.description: Effect samples recorded per minute by the objective the intervention served (agent_intervention_effect_delta_count); one sample per measured signal.
panels.title: Effect Measurements / min (by objective)

panels.description: Headless shadow games started per minute (games_started_total{game_kind="shadow"}).
panels.title: Shadow Games Started / min

panels.description: Shadow game starts rejected because a real game was running (policy=block). Source: game_shadow_games_blocked_total.
panels.title: Shadow Games Blocked (time range)

panels.description: Shadow games force-ended because a real game started. Source: game_shadow_games_preempted_total.
panels.title: Shadow Games Preempted (time range)

panels.description: Agent process CPU (rate of process_cpu_seconds_total). The job matcher accepts the namespaced job VictoriaMetrics stores (infrastructure/agent) and a bare agent.
panels.title: Agent CPU

panels.description: Agent resident memory (process_resident_memory_bytes), job matched as for Agent CPU.
panels.title: Agent Memory

title: Agent Decisions & Interventions
